chunks: The House was named al-Bayt al-‘Atiq because it was saved from drowning.

key_terms.الْبَيْتُ: the House, referring to the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْعَتِيقُ: the ancient or freed House; a title of the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْغَرَقِ: drowning or submersion in the flood

ai.seo_question: Why is the Ka'bah called al-Bayt al-‘Atiq?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the reason the Ka'bah is called al-Bayt al-‘Atiq. It states that the House was given this name because it was preserved from being submerged in the flood.
